title: 306. Max Points on a Line

examples.explanation: All three lie on the diagonal y = x.
The line through [1,4], [2,3], [3,2], [4,1] holds four points, which is maximal.

hints: Fix one anchor point and count normalized slopes to every other point.
Reduce (dx, dy) by their gcd and a canonical sign so identical lines share a key.
Handle vertical lines (dx = 0) as their own slope bucket.
